player_prompt.intro: Welcome to Lights Out! You have a {size}x{size} grid of lights. Your goal is to turn ALL lights OFF (represented by '.') Nigbati o ba tẹ ina kan, o yipada ara rẹ ati awọn aladugbo rẹ (oke / isalẹ / osi / ọtun). Type [row col] lati tẹ ina kan (0-indexed, nitorinaa ibiti o wulo jẹ 0-{max_index}). O ni to {max_turns} awọn gbigbe lati yanju adojuru naa. Àkọlé: 'O' = ina ON, '.' = ina OFF

board.current_state: Ipo grid lọwọlọwọ (Mọ {moves_made}, {moves_left} awọn gbigbe ti o ku, {completion}% pari): {grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Iṣe gbọdọ jẹ ni ọna kika [row col] nibiti ila ati ọwọn jẹ awọn nọmba odidi lati 0 si {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Awọn kọọdinẹti gbọdọ jẹ laarin 0 ati {max_index}. O tẹ [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Mo kí yín o! Ẹ yanjú àdììtú náà ní {moves_used} ìgbésẹ̀!
outcome.loss: Game over! O lo gbogbo {max_turns} ìgbésẹ̀ láì yanjú àdììtú náà. Ìparí ìparí: {completion}% Ìparí ìparí: {grid}
